verdict.rationale: The firm's own Executive Compensation, Employment & Benefits page says it handles compensation and employee benefits issues 'whatever the... stage of a company's development', which implies equity-plan work. The Emerging Companies glossary defines related terms such as 409A valuation, vesting schedules and cliff vesting, but these are glossary entries, not a described service. Missing for 10: any explicit description of designing option plans or ESOPs; any mention of local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs; any startup-specific equity-plan service page or tooling; independent corroboration.
